Name: Resculpted -  Warp Receiver Retexture
Author: mrtaiyou
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/pDJOJPm.png[/img]

[size=6] ﻿Resculpted, [/size][size=3]a warp obelisk retexture!
[/size]
Retextures the usual warp totem obelisks to give them a more charming look (we really needed it).

[size=5][u]Features:[/u][/size]

[b]Seasonal Changes

[/b]For the seasons Spring, Summer and Fall, each warp totem remains the same as shown in the image above. When entering the Winter season, Pelican Town's totems are retextured according to the vanilla modifications so that they blend in with the season.

[b]Compatible with recolors

[/b]The mod should be compatible with any Stardew recolor as long as it doesn't overlap the mod (I tested with Earthy Recolor and it worked accordingly). Changing the mod load order should fix this if anything happens though.

[b]Configurable

[/b]You can enable or disable any totem if you feel so!
